text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":9079529,"ns":0,"title":"Airshaft","extract":"In manufacturing, an airshaft is a device used for handling winding reels in the processing of web-fed materials, such as continuous-process printing presses.\nAirshafts—also called air expanding shafts—are used in the manufacturing processes for fitting into a core onto which materials such as paper, card and plastic film are wound.","description":"Device used in manufacturing","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
